title: a census names every reader outside our repos that reads a record by its json name
intention: One read-only instrument lists, per box, every file outside cairn and CairnCommons that names a record of truth by its .json name, split into code readers and prose mentions, with every declared root reported scanned or absent.
why: e78c9858f5fb's falsifier makes the outside-readers census its first piece and its WRONG-INTENT test: if a reader outside our repos needs .json, the extension carries information and the rename is the wrong intent. Measured 2026-11-13 on akienasus: no such census exists; a grep over ~/.claude, ~/.local/bin, ~/.config/systemd/user, ~/.akien and ~/dev/src/cc-memory finds prose mentions in cc-memory and one false-positive in a synced skill, and nothing records it.
traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured: the census is the measurement e78c9858f5fb's intent rests on); Law 1 (the rename is not re-derived per box: one instrument).
how: cairn/tools/artifact/outside_readers.py: census(roots=None) walks the declared outside roots (~/.claude minus projects/, ~/bin, ~/.local/bin, ~/.config/systemd/user, /etc/systemd/system, the user crontab, ~/.akien, every repo under ~/dev/src but cairn and CairnCommons), skips any path resolving inside the two repos and files over 2 MB, and greps each text file for a record name (CairnCommons/{tickets,troubles,decisions,slates,ideas,questions,adjudications}/*.json, intention+why.json, state.json, history.json, validations/*.json). A hit in .md/.txt is a mention; any other file is a reader. Returns {roots: [{root, status: scanned|absent}], readers: [{path, line, text}], mentions: [...]}; `python3 -m cairn.tools.artifact.outside_readers` prints it as JSON. The live finding is recorded on e78c9858f5fb's log.

clauses.claim: a code file naming tickets/<x>.json in a scratch outside root is listed as a reader with its path and line
a .md naming one is a mention, not a reader; a symlink resolving into an inside root, and a file inside the repos, are not counted
every declared root reads scanned or absent; an absent root is reported, never skipped silently
live over this box's declared roots the census completes, and every root reads scanned or absent

decisions.text: D1: the census is one read-only module in the artifact tool, with a JSON CLI, so each box runs the same instrument.
D2: the proof plants readers and mentions in scratch roots for clauses 1-3 and runs the live roots for clause 4, asserting invariants, never a count.
